Initial release of rd-initiation-review: structured pre-screen and evidence-backed audit system for R&D project proposals.

- Supports formal reviews, go/no-go decisions, public novelty boundary checks, innovation-point assessments, and project ratings.
- Multiple review modes: screen, review, innovation, and assurance, with clear default selection logic based on the user’s request.
- Emphasizes four-layer evidence tagging and strict separation of proposal claims vs. externally verified facts.
- Built-in novelty and material completeness review modules with explicit requirements for evidence backing and open gap documentation.
- Flexible tool routing and fallback—from structured patent/paper search to web and LLM-only, with confidence grading and explicit downgrades when evidence levels drop.
- Automatically produces a full review report, novelty note, and traceable evidence files in a prescribed file set.
